en: Color postcard showing the front view of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall square towers and a row of arches and statues on the façade. In the foreground there is a plaza with flower beds and a central statue on a pedestal. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard layout with multilingual caption identifying the cathedral in Pécs, Hungary, plus printer and price information.
